name: io.github.theluckystrike/hospital-ratings-cms-star-ratings-mcp
title: Hospital Ratings and CMS Star Ratings MCP
description: CMS hospital star ratings, patient survey stars and ER wait times for US hospitals (Care Compare).

tools.name: hospital_search
tools.description: Find US hospitals by state, city, county, ZIP code (5 digits, or a 3-digit prefix for the area) or name, with each hospital's CMS overall star rating (1 to 5), HCAHPS patient survey summary stars, type, ownership and ER availability. Best rated first, with the count at each star level. Filter by type, minimum stars or emergency services.

state.description: State code or name, such as MA or Massachusetts.

zip.description: ZIP code (02114) or a 3-digit ZIP prefix for the surrounding area (021).

min_stars.description: Only hospitals with at least this overall star rating.

emergency_services.description: Only hospitals with an emergency department.

limit.description: How many hospitals to list, 1 to 50. Default 20.

tools.name: hospital_ratings
tools.description: Full CMS Care Compare ratings for one hospital (by facility id, or name with state or city): overall star rating with the reason when unrated; how many mortality, safety and readmission measures are better, no different or worse than the national rate; HCAHPS patient survey stars overall and by topic (nurses, doctors, cleanliness, quiet, discharge), share rating it 9 or 10 and who would recommend it against national; ER median time from arrival to leaving, left without being seen, sepsis care and staff flu vaccination, each against the state and national average.

facility_id.description: CMS facility id (CCN), 6 characters such as 220071. Best when known (hospital_search returns it).

name.description: Hospital name or part of it, such as "Mass General" or "Brigham and Women's".

state.description: State code or name. Narrows a name lookup.

tools.name: hospital_compare
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 hospitals side by side on CMS overall stars, patient survey stars, the share of patients rating it 9 or 10 and who would recommend it, ER median time, left before being seen, sepsis care and mortality, safety and readmission measures better or worse than national. Names which hospital leads each.

facility_id.description: CMS facility id (CCN), 6 characters such as 220071. Best when known (hospital_search returns it).

name.description: Hospital name or part of it, such as "Mass General" or "Brigham and Women's".

state.description: State code or name. Narrows a name lookup.

hospitals.description: 2 to 5 hospitals, each { facility_id } or { name, state } (city optional).
